policy: RootLens reserves all rights necessary for licensing under copyright, sui generis database rights, and analogous regimes. Text and data mining (TDM) of the video content hosted via RootLens, including but not limited to use as training, evaluation, fine-tuning, or synthetic-data input for any AI or machine-learning model, is not permitted absent the purchase of a License NFT from RootLens.
applies_to: Video content bound to Bubblegum cNFTs minted under the RootLens Title Protocol Root NFT collection (Solana mainnet and devnet) and the associated derived assets (frames, audio tracks, embeddings, captions).
Files served from https://rootlens.io/v/, https://rootlens.io/p/, and any CDN paths derived therefrom (currently routed through Cloudflare R2 public buckets under rootlens-public).
legal_basis: EU CDSM Directive 2019/790 Art. 4(3): machine-readable rights reservation against TDM exceptions.
UK CDPA s.29A reservation by rightsholders (text and data mining for non-commercial research).
US: copyright reservation, with TDM positions per Authors Guild v. Google (2nd Cir. 2015) and ongoing litigation post-fair-use analyses.
JP: Copyright Act Art. 30-4 exclusion for cases where the rightsholder has expressed a reservation against use that unjustly harms their interests.
